## mep edit

`mep edit MESSAGE_ID TEXT` updates a message you sent, in place, through the same consent gate as a new one: it checks read-only that the message exists and is yours, stores an edit draft, and `mep send DRAFT_ID` applies it (Zulip `PATCH /messages/{id}`) and prints `edited SOURCE message ID`. `mep drafts` shows it as `EDIT of message ID`.

Failures exit 1 with a reason on stderr and never count as sent: the message is gone or not yours, Zulip is unreachable, or the realm's edit time limit has passed (`edit window expired`; post a new message instead).

Built for scripts such as a release bot that posts one status message and updates it as stages finish. `mep send` prints `sent SOURCE message ID`; the id is the last word.
